entry.title: Reserva Especial El Jocko Maduro — Single
experienceTags: Pairings: Espresso, dark chocolate, dark rum
Occasion: Compact evening perfecto, after-dinner smoke
entry.summaryHtml: Dark cocoa, espresso, cedar, earth, anise and black pepper drive this compact Broadleaf perfecto. The Nicaraguan binder and Dominican core keep the smoke savoury and woody beneath the darker wrapper sweetness, while the tapered shape starts concentrated before opening into the 54-ring centre.
entry.noteHtml: Cigar World lists the exact El Jocko Maduro single at A$37.14.
